motivation.stage_A_result: The corrected 2018-2025 hindcast retained a raw Host+ risk ratio of 1.65 but showed no resource-placement signal after preserving species and WGSRPD level-1 geography (p=0.46542); therefore short-window realization is not supported.
motivation.next_question: Does the chronology of the actual known larval resource, rather than generic alien-plant chronology, preferentially precede butterfly occurrence in introduced-only resource regions?

panel.butterflies: the same 31 species in the frozen full-history GBIF bulk download
panel.resource_cells: all introduced-only known-host cells: contemporary WCVP known-host union minus native WCVP known-host union
panel.outcome_selection: No 2018-2025 event filter is used to define the primary chronology panel. Resource cells are defined from frozen HOSTS-WCVP data before inspecting the global butterfly first-record map.

chronology.butterfly_time: earliest mapped GBIF record in each butterfly x WGSRPD3 cell from the 1800-2025 bulk download
chronology.actual_resource_time: earliest mapped GBIF record among the focal butterfly's known host species that WCVP classifies as introduced in that WGSRPD3 region
chronology.interpretation_of_lag: Positive means the documented host record precedes the documented butterfly record; zero/negative does not prove biological reversal because first records are sampling dates.

matched_pseudoresource_null.construction: For each actual introduced known host in a cell, replace it with one alien plant that is introduced in the same WGSRPD3 region but is not a documented host of that butterfly.
matched_pseudoresource_null.resource_richness_preserved: Sample one pseudo plant for each actual host, then define pseudo resource time as the earliest local record among the sampled pseudo plants.

primary_endpoint.statistic: number (or fraction) of cells in which documented resource time is <= butterfly first-record time
primary_endpoint.null: distribution of the same host-before-butterfly statistic after matched pseudo-resource replacement
primary_endpoint.decision: Identity-specific temporal precedence is supported only if the actual statistic exceeds the matched pseudo-resource null at one-sided Monte Carlo p <= 0.05.

secondary_endpoints: signed lag distribution (butterfly year minus resource year)
median positive lag among host-first cells
actual-minus-pseudo difference in median signed lag
fraction of cells with negative, zero, and positive lags
sensitivity to requiring >=3, >=5, or 10 dated pseudo-host candidates per actual host

censored_extension.description: For introduced-only cells with documented resource time but no butterfly record by 2025, treat butterfly occurrence as right-censored and examine whether years since documented resource appearance predicts realization. Do not promote this to primary unless the identity-specific precedence test is positive.

interpretation_rules.identity_specific_precedence: Actual known-host chronology precedes butterfly chronology more often than matched alien non-host chronology. This supports a resource-consumer temporal mismatch / resource-tracking lag interpretation.
interpretation_rules.generic_alien_chronology: Actual and pseudo resources show similar precedence. Long apparent lags are attributable to generic alien-plant residence and recording history, not known-host identity.
interpretation_rules.no_resource_first_pattern: Actual resources do not preferentially precede butterflies. Reject the resource-first temporal mismatch narrative.

claim_boundaries: First record is not establishment or colonization.
GBIF plant and butterfly sampling histories differ; pseudo plants are used to absorb plant-side residence and recording structure.
Known host presence does not establish local larval use, abundance, quality, or demographic benefit.
The analysis is post-hoc relative to the original main paper and must remain outside the GEB manuscript unless independently validated.
Do not use the labels invasion debt, colonization credit, or trophic debt as headline concepts unless the matched pseudo-resource test is positive and robust.
stop_rule: If actual host timing does not exceed the matched pseudo-resource null, terminate the temporal-mismatch branch rather than adding new simulation assumptions.
